prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1324; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision described below, which occurred when your insured's vehicle sideswiped our client's vehicle while changing lanes. Our client has sustained injuries that are being evaluated and treated, and we anticipate a claim for damages arising from this incident.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office. Do not contact our client directly, in person, by telephone, or in writing. If you have received any statement from our client, please notify us immediately.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured for this loss, along with a copy of the declarations page.

We also ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data, dash camera or telematics records, claim file materials, witness statements, recorded calls, and any repair or appraisal records. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained.
